rdfs:label: notation
rdfs:comment: A string of characters, such as "510" or "QA76", that uniquely identifies a SKOS Concept within a given scheme, typed with a datatype that names the notation system (e.g. Dewey Decimal, UDC, LCC class marks).
notes: Unlike `skos:prefLabel` (a human-readable string in a natural language), `skos:notation` is a typed literal whose datatype identifies the notation system — e.g. a Dewey Decimal code typed as `<https://example.org/dewey-code>` is distinct from a UDC code with the same digits. A Concept may carry multiple notations from different schemes. Upstream SKOS declares no domain for `notation`.
